_: THE CHECK CATALOG of the verification service (SecurityInsight Pro; docs/V3-DATA-MODEL.md 2.11): settings and plans SecurityInsight's data depends on that are NOT enabled in the customer's Microsoft estate. Each check has a stable id (never renamed -- decisions and history are keyed by it), a title, WHY it matters for SecurityInsight's results, the FIX, a severity (high | medium | low | info), the scope it applies to (tenant | subscription | device | resource | workspace | engine) and the source it reads. The service is READ-ONLY: it never changes a setting. state: production = evaluated and shown; testing = evaluated and shown as testing; not_used = not evaluated. A check whose source cannot be read is NOT CHECKED with the reason -- never 'no gaps' (working rule 4).

unsupportedOs.note: devices enrolled in Extended Security Updates can be ignored with a decision

checks.title: A Defender for Cloud plan is off on a subscription
checks.why: Without the plan, Defender for Cloud produces no recommendations, vulnerability assessments or alerts for that resource type in that subscription -- SecurityInsight then shows those resources with no findings, which reads as 'secure' when it is 'unknown'.
checks.fix: In Defender for Cloud > Environment settings > the subscription > Defender plans, turn the plan on (or decide to ignore it here with a reason).
checks.source: Azure Resource Graph: securityresources (microsoft.security/pricings) and the subscriptions

checks.title: An Azure virtual machine has no Defender for Endpoint sensor
checks.why: A running VM that Defender for Endpoint does not know has no vulnerability, software or exposure data -- SecurityInsight cannot score it and it is missing from every device report.
checks.fix: Onboard the VM to Defender for Endpoint (Defender for Servers integration, or the onboarding package).
checks.source: Azure Resource Graph: running virtual machines; Defender for Endpoint: machines (vmMetadata, name)

checks.title: An active Entra device has no Defender for Endpoint sensor
checks.why: A Windows or macOS device that signs in to Entra but is not in Defender for Endpoint has no vulnerability or software data -- SecurityInsight cannot score it.
checks.fix: Onboard the device to Defender for Endpoint (Intune onboarding policy, Group Policy or the onboarding package).
checks.source: Microsoft Graph: devices (active within the staleness window); Defender for Endpoint: machines (aadDeviceId, name)

checks.title: A Defender for Endpoint sensor is not reporting
checks.why: A device whose sensor is inactive or impaired, or has not reported within the heartbeat window, gives SecurityInsight data that is out of date -- its findings and exposure may no longer be true.
checks.fix: Check the sensor on the device (service running, connectivity to the Defender endpoints); offboard devices that are gone.

checks.title: A device runs an operating system that is out of support
checks.why: An operating system past its end of support receives no security updates -- every vulnerability SecurityInsight finds on it stays open, and new ones are not fixed.
checks.fix: Upgrade or replace the device, or enrol it in Extended Security Updates and record that here as a decision.

checks.title: No Defender for Cloud connector for AWS or GCP
checks.why: Without a multicloud connector, resources in AWS or GCP are not seen by Defender for Cloud or by SecurityInsight. If the organisation uses no other cloud, ignore this with that reason.
checks.fix: In Defender for Cloud > Environment settings, add the AWS account or GCP project.

checks.title: An Advanced Hunting table SecurityInsight reads is empty
checks.why: SecurityInsight reads devices, vulnerabilities, the Exposure Graph and identities from Advanced Hunting. An empty table means there is no data: the Defender product behind it is not deployed, its licence is missing, or it has not collected yet -- those parts of the reports are then missing, not clean.
checks.fix: Deploy or license the Defender product that fills the table (Defender for Endpoint, Defender Vulnerability Management, Exposure Management, Defender for Identity).
checks.source: Advanced Hunting: the tables in huntingTables

checks.title: Sign-in or audit logs do not reach the security workspace
checks.why: SecurityInsight reads sign-in and audit logs from the security workspace for identity activity. Without them, identity findings that depend on sign-ins are incomplete.
checks.fix: Send the Entra sign-in and audit logs to the workspace (Entra ID > Diagnostic settings, or the Microsoft Entra ID data connector in Sentinel).
checks.source: Log Analytics: the tables in signInTables in the security workspace (SI_DefenderWorkspaceResourceId)

checks.title: A SecurityInsight collector did not complete its last run
checks.why: A collector that failed, ran partially or did not run in the last day leaves SecurityInsight's view of that area out of date -- what it would have found is unknown, not resolved.
checks.fix: Open Jobs in the web app, read the failed run's log, and fix the cause (permissions, timeouts, size).
checks.source: Log Analytics: SI_RunHealth_CL in SecurityInsight's workspace
